entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about an order I received last week. It's for the Trail Helmet.
Of course, I can help with that. Could I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF-8675309.
Thank you, Alex. I see your order for the Trail Helmet, delivered 7 days ago. What specifically is the issue with the helmet?
There's no issue with it, really. I just don't love the color in person as much as I did online. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched the helmet itself. I'd like to return it.
I understand completely. Sometimes the color just doesn't look the same on a screen. Let me check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, Alex, I've pulled up our policy. Since the helmet was delivered just seven days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you.

That's great news, thank you. Now, since I have to package it up and send it back, and given I'm a long-time customer, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? I'm going to order a different helmet.

That's a reasonable request. Let me see... I see here you're a VIP member with us, Alex. Thank you for your loyalty. For the inconvenience, I can do more than that. I'll go ahead and waive the return shipping fee and I've also added a 20% discount code to your account that you can use on your next order.
Oh, wow. That's perfect. Waiving the shipping and a 20% discount is more than I was expecting. Thank you, Diana.

You are very welcome. We want to make sure you get the right gear. Your safety on the trail is what's most important, and that starts with a helmet you'll be happy to wear. I've just emailed you the prepaid return label. Just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off. The discount is already active on your account.
Excellent. I appreciate your help. You've made this very easy.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Alex?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
